passages.note: Vote page: only one DUNN appears in the roster, the header shows the House chamber, and 26 No of 60 is far from near-unanimous.

passages.provision_quote: Except for a form produced by the United States election assistance commission, any application for registration shall be accompanied by satisfactory evidence of citizenship as prescribed in section 16-166, subsection F, and the county recorder or other officer in charge of elections shall reject any application for registration that is not accompanied by satisfactory evidence of citizenship.
passages.note: Enacted text page of the same record; the quoted operative subsection contains no deleted-text fence, and every section is within qualification and registration of electors, so the bill is single-subject.
Status page of the same record: it confirms the chaptered House Engrossed version Dunn voted on, and Dunn is not among the listed sponsors, so the vote is his only act on this bill.

rows.reasoning: Dunn is recorded "DUNN Y" on HB2492 at House Third Reading, "Passed 31-26-3-0-0", a vote cast during his Arizona House term, which counts for his Senate seat under the earlier-chamber rule for records of the same legislature. The enacted text requires that any registration application "shall be accompanied by satisfactory evidence of citizenship as prescribed in section 16-166, subsection F" and directs the recorder to "reject any application for registration that is not accompanied by satisfactory evidence of citizenship", which is the rung "Require documentary proof of citizenship to register to vote."
